versions.changelog:
Initial release of 1688 竞店竞品分析 skill.

- Provides competitive shop and product analysis based on real data from 生意参谋「竞争」接口 and buyer loss information.
- Supports full workflow: identify competitors, compare key indicators, analyze winning strategies, and explore actionable suggestions.
- Covers store-level competitive analysis by default; product-level analysis available on user request.
- Includes structured output for core indicators, hot products, price bands, leading search terms, and multi-dimensional buyer structure.
- All data strictly comes from actual interface returns—no fabrication; only works in Accio Desktop environment with merchant authorization.
- Multiple trigger phrases supported for flexible interaction (e.g. 竞争分析, 竞店分析, 客户流失到哪, 同行对比, 等).
